scriptLines: charge_type = case(isNull(charge_type) || trim(charge_type) == '' || lower(trim(charge_type)) == 'null', 'No registrado', instr(lower(trim(charge_type)), 'surg') > 0, 'Surgery', instr(lower(trim(charge_type)), 'med') > 0, 'Medication', instr(lower(trim(charge_type)), 'imag') > 0, 'Imaging', instr(lower(trim(charge_type)), 'room') > 0, 'Room', instr(lower(trim(charge_type)), 'lab') > 0, 'Lab Test', instr(lower(trim(charge_type)), 'consult') > 0, 'Consultation', trim(charge_type)),

amount = case(isNull(amount) || trim(amount) == '' || lower(trim(amount)) == 'null', toDecimal(0.00, 12, 2), toDecimal(regexReplace(replace(replace(replace(amount, '$', ''), ',', ''), 'USD', ''), ' ', ''), 12, 2) < 0, toDecimal(0.00, 12, 2), toDecimal(regexReplace(replace(replace(replace(amount, '$', ''), ',', ''), 'USD', ''), ' ', ''), 12, 2)),

payment_status = case(isNull(payment_status) || trim(payment_status) == '' || lower(trim(payment_status)) == 'null', 'No registrado', lower(trim(payment_status)) == 'paid', 'Paid', lower(trim(payment_status)) == 'pending', 'Pending', lower(trim(payment_status)) == 'overdue', 'Overdue', lower(trim(payment_status)) == 'unpaid', 'Unpaid', initCap(trim(payment_status))),

derivedColumn derive(payment_date = iif(isNull(payment_date), toDate(null()), iif(year(payment_date) < 100, addMonths(payment_date, 24000), iif(year(payment_date) < 1900, toDate(null()), payment_date)))) ~> derivedColumn1
